_readme: Confidence thresholds for the Jev typed-judgment consumers, PER QUESTION KIND.
these shipped values are the PRE-CALIBRATION defaults and are deliberately high.
Posture until calibration has run on real Woven data: flag, never block.
low  - below this, escalate the item to a Claude read
high - at or above this, the verdict may be acted on
noul - the 0-1 point at which a noul statement counts as TRUE
